ev.q: Since 2004, CDC has received notification of three separate incidents of exposure to sulfur mustard munitions.
two members required treatment for chemical burns after large pus-filled blisters developed on their hands and arms.
One EOD team member required hospitalization as a result of the exposure.
None of the potentially exposed persons developed signs or symptoms of exposure to mustard.
